title: Days Since You Last LAUGHED 🤫
description:
Everyone here shows a number over their head: the days since they last laughed. Most people never get past one. My brother Tam is at forty.

He's been cramming every afternoon under the silent dome of the old reading room, and something with no number at all keeps ending up a table nearer to him.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment ZERO if you laughed today.
